host: Dedicated EC2 c7i.4xlarge, 8 physical cores / 16 vCPUs, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws, OpenJDK 21.0.13.1 and Python 3.12.3. Dive uses the bundled CPython 3.11.14 and CUDD 3.0.0.
command: dive check ToyMutex.tla --config ToyMutex.cfg --strategy symbolic --property-proof Mutex --output json
original_refusal: expected one source layout operator named TypeOK when the previous panel supplied --type-invariant TypeOK
comparison_method: Five cold alternating pairs from recomp_property_panel.py with --seconds 30 --config toy_mutex/2/ToyMutex.cfg --cgroup-parent GROUP. The adapter omitted the layout flag. Peak counts the whole process family.

controls.old_explicit_invocation: still refuses the absent named TypeOK
controls.unbounded_counter_mutation: enabled assignment leaves bounds for globalVar
controls.independent_exact_range_witness: with the counter guard removed, exact Core reaches globalVar = 2 and validates the word against the original candidate range 0..Max
controls.double_entry_mutation: both inferred named proof and single-worker exact Core report Mutex at depth 3, and the named word replays independently
controls.transfer: GrantTable infers a Boolean map; exact Core and named proof agree on the original and double-grant mutation
